propositions: Auto-deploy container restart during in-flight code review times out the shutdown drain (45s) before the review completes (up to 1200s), forcing a worker cancel that fail-closes a LLM-Review -1 vote
The fail-closed -1 vote blocks the backfill reconciler from re-driving the change, making every occurrence require manual human re-trigger
Transient GitHub git-fetch hangs (300s timeout) are misclassified as vote-bearing coverage gaps instead of retryable conditions, preventing automatic recovery
Raising DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s allows in-flight reviews to complete without interruption

Coverage-gap decisions with retryable gap_reason values (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) must post no vote and record an attempt, leaving the change eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive
After RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS consecutive failures on the same revision, the review-bot must escalate by casting a fail-closed -1 vote with exhaustion note and emitting VOTER_ERROR alarm
